root_cause.text: The `cifs_set_cifscreds` function in the SMB client subsystem inappropriately uses the `cifs_dbg` macro to log the raw keyring payload, exposing sensitive plaintext credentials in the system log when debug logging is enabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the line `cifs_dbg(FYI, "payload=%s\n", payload);` from `fs/smb/client/connect.c` within the `cifs_set_cifscreds` function, which was printing the unparsed credential payload.
